response.original_title: Will I be able to speak and eat normally after surgery?
response.overview: Many patients can speak and eat well after head and neck cancer surgery, but recovery can be different for each person. It mainly depends on the location and size of the cancer and the type of surgery required. A head and neck cancer surgeon may need to operate on areas such as the tongue, mouth, jaw, throat, or neck. In some cases, patients may have temporary difficulty with speaking, chewing, or swallowing after surgery. With proper care, speech therapy, swallowing exercises, and reconstruction, many patients gradually improve these functions. If you are looking for a head and neck cancer surgeon in Ahmedabad, it is important to discuss your expected recovery before surgery. Your surgeon can explain how the planned treatment may affect speaking, eating, swallowing, and daily activities.
